title: RAM benchmark data with stated clocks and timings

conventions.field: every config field is {value, basis[, note]}; basis ∈ stated | inferred | not_stated. 'stated' = printed by the source; 'inferred' = derived by the compiler (note says how).
conventions.measurement: {metric, value, unit, basis, spread[, relative_to][, note]}; spread is null when the source gives none, else {type, ...}: stdev_pct, or range_across_dual_channel_configs {min,max} (value then null).
conventions.relative: metrics ending in _rel are percent differences vs the entry named in relative_to.
conventions.units: bandwidth kept in the unit the source used (MB/s or GB/s); latency in ns. Theoretical peak is not stored: compute channels x mt_s x 8 B.
conventions.quality_flags: free-form tags (single_run, windows, partial, anecdotal, primaries_missing, ...).
conventions.sequence: entries sharing sequence.group are one system changed step by step; changed_from_previous names the change.
